panel.title: Tools
panel.description: Select an area, process it, then inspect and export the results.

process.title: Process
process.description: Derives two layers from the AOI and publishes a legend for each.

layer_panel.description: The layers on the map, top first. Drag a row by its handle to reorder them; expand it for its opacity, legend and style.

add_layers.title: Add layers
add_layers.description: Add a standalone demo layer, a Sentinel-1 radar composite or a PMTiles vector layer, or clear the map and its legends. Each one is listed in the layer panel above.

export.title: Export
export.description: Send the AOI or a processed output to Earth Engine, Drive or SEPAL.

tasks.adding_layers: Adding derived layers to the map...

toasts.process_done: Processing complete. Pick a layer in the map legend to inspect it.

errors.no_aoi: Select an AOI first before running processing.
errors.simulated: Simulated failure: external API returned malformed JSON at line 42.

export.aoi_description: The AOI feature collection currently selected in the sidebar.
export.pixel_area_description: Continuous output. Its map legend is the gradient built from vis_params.
export.elevation_description: Classified output. Its legend lists per-class areas in the detail column.
export.multi_band_description: Shows the ExportLauncher band picker: keep every band or narrow to a subset.

files.intro: Every way FileInputComponent selects paths. Under each field is the value the app receives.

single.title: One file
single.label: Select a file
single.description: The default. The value is one path, a str.

multiple.title: Several files
multiple.label: Select files
multiple.description: multiple=True. A click on a file adds or removes it, and the selection stays when you open another folder. The value is a list[str].

extensions.title: Several files of one type
extensions.label: Select vector files
extensions.description: multiple=True with extensions: only .geojson, .gpkg, .kml and .shp files are listed.

folders.title: Files and folders
folders.label: Select files or folders
folders.description: multiple=True with select_folders=True. The check on a folder selects it, and a click on the row still opens it.

preset.title: A selection set by the app
preset.label: Select files
preset.description: multiple=True with a list as value: the field opens with those paths selected, here the two sample files. Through a SEPAL session they are not in your workspace, so it opens empty.

no_clear.title: No clear button
no_clear.label: Select files
no_clear.description: multiple=True with clearable=False: remove paths one at a time from the field's menu.
